Latin reader locale

Latina — the la reader pack. Script: Latin; direction: left-to-right.

FieldValue
Locale codela
Native nameLatina
ScriptLatin
Directionleft-to-right

The canonical pack. Every other pack is a translation of this one, and the pack key — the canonical name — is the Latin spelling.

Latin ↔ English#

Generated from the packs. The Latin column is the canonical name — the pack key and the compiler's internal identity; the English column is the base-surface spelling. The other reader languages lead with English on their mapping pages.
